subtitle: Settings, masking and catalog as one text: checked as you type, applied with a separate button
unsaved: You have edits, the file is not applied
removal: Removing an entry or an environment from the text does not delete it: it stays in the project and comes back in the file. Hide an entry with hidden: true, remove an environment on the Environments form.
readOnlyRole: The file is read-only for your role: you can search, copy and download it.
readOnlyClosed: Editing is closed: the database is read-only or updating. Your text stays and can be downloaded; upload and apply return when editing reopens.
refreshed: The project changed: the text was replaced with a fresh export.
tooLarge: The text is {{size}} MB, over the {{max}} MB limit: such a file cannot be applied. Viewing, editing and downloading work; checks resume once the text is within the limit.
appliedNoText: The changes were applied, but the fresh text could not be loaded. This text is read-only, there is no need to apply it again.

syntax.at: Syntax error: line {{line}}, column {{col}}. Such text is not checked on the server.
syntax.noPosition: Syntax error: the text cannot be parsed, for example too deep nesting or too many aliases. Such text is not checked on the server.

check.waiting: Waiting for a pause to check
check.unavailable: Check unavailable: the database is not responding. Your text stays, the check repeats at the next pause.
check.timeout: The server did not respond. Your text stays, the check runs on the next edit or button press.
check.forbidden: The server refused: your role does not allow checking the file. Your text stays and can be downloaded.
check.unreachable: The Threadline server is not responding. Your text stays.
check.failed: The check failed. Your text stays.
check.session: The session expired: sign in in a new tab, your text stays.

conflict.title: The project changed while you were editing
conflict.help: Your text stays and can be downloaded. “Keep my edits” checks it again and shows what will change, including undoing other people's edits. “Load fresh file” replaces the text.

confirm.comments: Comments will be lost: the other format has none. Change the format?
confirm.replace: Replace your edits with the text of this file?
confirm.fresh: Replace your text with a fresh export? Your edits will be lost.

load.title: The project file did not open
load.unavailable: The catalog database is unavailable. Try again later.
load.forbidden: The server refused: your role does not allow this action.
load.unreachable: The Threadline server is not responding.
load.session: The session expired: sign in again.
load.blocked: Export refused: masking would hide values in these fields, so there is no text.
load.blockedHelp: Fix the values in the catalog or project settings sections with these fields. You can upload a file with corrected values.

problem.formatBroken: Format not changed: syntax error on line {{line}}. Your text stays.
problem.formatBrokenNoLine: Format not changed: the text cannot be parsed. Your text stays.
problem.formatTooLarge: Format not changed: the text is over {{max}} MB. Your text stays.
problem.freshFailed: Fresh file not received, your text stays: {{reason}}
problem.fileType: This file does not fit: .yaml, .yml or .json is needed. The text in the editor did not change.
problem.fileTooBig: The file is over {{max}} MB and cannot be uploaded. The text in the editor did not change.
problem.fileEncoding: The file is not in UTF-8. The text in the editor did not change.
problem.overLimit: Paste refused: the text would exceed 8 million characters. Your text and undo history stay.
problem.applyFailed: The file was not applied, the text and report stay, you can apply again: {{reason}}

report.empty: The report appears after an edit: it shows what will be added, changed and hidden.
report.stale: The report is out of date: the text changed. A new check is running.
report.stopsSearches: Running searches of this project will stop, as when saving the form.
report.comments: The file is built from the database: comments are not kept and disappear after applying.
report.onlyComments: Comments are not kept: the file is built from the database. You can download the text with them.
report.orderNotKept: The order of entries and keys in the file is not kept.
report.missingStay: Entries missing from the text stay in the project. To hide an entry, set hidden: true on it.
report.keyChange: If you changed the method, address, rpc or conditions, this is a new entry and the old one stays. Hide the old one with hidden: true, otherwise the catalog will have both.
report.envRemoval: Environments missing from the text stay in the project. Remove an environment on the form
report.notApplied: Edits to these entries were not applied, the text now has their values from the database:
report.warnings: The file will apply, but these fields do not work the way you might think. Each line says what to do:
